title: The D Cut
summary: The D Cut follows an iconic queer hair salon fighting to stay open amid neighbourhood gentrification. D "Marie Marolle", hairdresser and local icon, believes everyone is just a cut away from living their best life and provides a safe space for queer cuts on a pay-what-you-can basis. On Crave.
